title: International Postgraduate Diploma In Media and Entertainment
description: Explore the global media and entertainment landscape with our course, delving into industry trends, digital innovation, and cultural impacts for aspiring media professionals worldwide.
longDescription: The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Media and Entertainment offers a comprehensive exploration of the dynamic and rapidly evolving media industry. It provides a rich collaborative learning experience where learners exchange views with other participants, interact with research-active tutors, and are challenged to become reflective managers. Focusing on practical experience, the course goes beyond traditional lectures, incorporating real-world scenarios, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning. This hands-on approach enables participants to apply new skills in a safe setting before transitioning to real-world situations. The IPGD in Media and Entertainment can be completed in 9 months, offering a quick pathway to career advancement and new opportunities. The diploma combines theoretical concepts with practical experience, equipping learners to address complex operational issues confidently and effectively.
courseDetails: The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Media and Entertainment aims to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of global media and entertainment industry dynamics, focusing on production, management, and business strategies. This program combines practical skills with theoretical insights, preparing graduates to innovate and excel in a rapidly evolving industry. Course Details: Management Information System: Understand the role of information systems in managing media operations and supporting decision-making processes in entertainment organizations. Media and Communication Industry: Explores the dynamics and structure of the media sector. Operations Management: Explore critical principles of operations management and how they apply to media production and entertainment business workflows. Events Planning and Management: Provides insights into organizing, coordinating, and managing events, from concept to execution, focusing on industry best practices. Strategic Management: Discusses formulating, implementing, and evaluating cross-functional decisions that enable organizations to achieve long-term objectives. Business Research Methods: Introduces techniques for conducting rigorous business research, including data collection, analysis, and interpretation, to support strategic decision-making. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) After completing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project (GP) integrating knowledge from all modules. This project assesses their ability to apply current practices in media and entertainment and solidifies their comprehensive understanding of the field. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises six modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

These courses can be taken as personal or professional development and may enhance your employability. Gaining deep insight into successful business strategies is a must for business professionals and managers alike. That’s because no matter where you are in your career, it’s critical to understand the market your business is in and the effect your leadership and decision-making can have on your company’s success. How else can you maintain your company’s value proposition, increase market share, and remain competitive? Strategic management is important because it helps in setting detailed goals, analyzing all our internal and external resources, analyzing our external environment, as well as stakeholder views. Hence, undertaking CPD is essential to support a professional in his/her current role as well as helping them with career progression. CPD is about upgrading knowledge, skills, and capabilities to remain effective and compliant. A CPD course is an investment that you make in yourself. It’s a way of planning your development that links learning directly to practice. CPD can help you keep your skills and knowledge up to date and prepare you for greater responsibilities. It can boost your confidence, strengthen your professional credibility, and help you become more creative in tackling new challenges. Is the SEMP Strategic Business Management Programme right for me? title: Special Executive Masters Programme in Business Management
description: The SEMP Business Management program emphasizes preparation for practical decision-making in a business environment.
longDescription: Course Overview The GSS Special Executive Masters Programmes (SEMP) allows you to update your skills, develop new skills, and explore and develop interests in various topics. These courses can be taken as personal or professional development and may enhance your employability. Economic knowledge and good administration are crucial to prosperity and progress in modern society. For both customers and employees, it is important that companies and public institutions are administered well. At the same time, good administration significantly impacts a company’s bottom-line figures. One of the keywords in Business Administration is management, and as a SEMP BM student, you will gain insight into both financial and psychological aspects of management. The online Programme will provide you with a wide range of skills that will qualify you for many positions in the public or private sectors. The Business Management courses will provide insight into Organisational theory, management psychology, marketing, planning, microeconomics, and cost management. You will learn how to locate and analyze management issues, such as increasing customer satisfaction; you will also learn how international conditions, technology, the global economy, or legislation influence companies and institutions.
courseDetails: Mode of Study Using Web-based technology, this program provides self-paced, individualized instruction that can be taken anywhere and anytime an individual has access to a computer and the Internet. This programme is suitable for successful professionals or specialists in the private, public, or voluntary sectors who have new management responsibilities and need to expand their management knowledge quickly. This Programme serves as a refresher course for those who had their Masters's a long time ago and need quick reminders and professional/ academic updates. At the same time, it also serves as a primer for those very experienced Professionals who never made time out for their masters. Yet, they require the academic and practical relevance of this master’s experience. It is a short executive training that runs online for three months. Upon successfully completing the Programme, candidates will be awarded a Continuing Professional Development (CPD) certificate in the specific Programme they have achieved. What is a CPD Course? Continuing Professional Development (CPD) is the means by which professionals maintain and enhance their knowledge and skills. The world is constantly moving at a very fast pace. Hence, undertaking CPD is essential to support a professional in his/her current role as well as helping them with career progression. CPD is all about upgrading knowledge, skills, and capabilities to remain effective and compliant. A CPD course is an investment that you make in yourself. It’s a way of planning your development that links learning directly to practice. CPD can help you keep your skills and knowledge up to date and prepare you for greater responsibilities. It can boost your confidence, strengthen your professional credibility, and help you become more creative in tackling new challenges. Is the SEMP Business Management Programme right for me? The ultimate aim of the SEMP Business Management program is to prepare participants to work in a management position in an ever-changing international environment where advanced technology and multicultural situations occupy an increasingly important place in the daily lives of companies. It exposes you to key issues in business management, and provides insight into relevant social, political, legal, and macroeconomic conditions affecting business. The online Programme is suited to a wide range of interests. Still, it is particularly relevant to those who plan to have a career in organizations that conduct business beyond a single domestic economy. Why SEMP Business Management? Succeeding in today's economy requires communicating and collaborating globally with a diversified workforce. The business world is constantly fluctuating, and successful business people must be adaptive to change and capable of working with diverse populations. The function of business is to create fiscal integrity and stability, prosperity, employment, and beneficial products and services. The online SEMP Business Management Programme will help you understand big and small businesses, and entrepreneurship, along with the important relationship between businesses and the communities they serve. Who should enrol in this online Certificate Program? The SEMP Business Management Programme is designed for entry-level managers, up to mid-level managers, senior managers or directors, and consultants who are in a general management role or fast approaching such a position and are seeking an opportunity to obtain a richer, deeper understanding of management skills. The SEMP Business Management Program is ideal for professionals of all levels. This Programme provides practical skills to overcome daily challenges by providing participants with the latest management principles and techniques.

title: Special Executive Programme In Agile Project Management
description: This special executive programme will equip professionals with Agile Project Management skills, ensuring efficient, adaptive project delivery.
longDescription: This special executive programme in Agile Project Management provides a comprehensive overview of Agile methods, covering principles, values, and methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, and Lean. Participants will learn to identify the benefits and drawbacks of Agile, understand the Agile Manifesto, and delve into Agile project management roles and best practices. The course also explores the implementation of Agile within organizations, addressing cultural considerations, strategies for introducing Agile, and scaling Agile across the entire organization. Additionally, it covers Scrum roles, events, artefacts, and insights into Agile Project Management with Kanban, offering practical knowledge and strategies for real-world application.
courseDetails: Understand the importance of organizational culture and structure in Agile implementation. Identify strategies for introducing Agile methods to an organization, including pilot projects and executive sponsorship. Learn how to create an Agile implementation plan and identify success metrics. Understand how to train and coach team members in Agile practices. Identify common challenges in Agile implementation and strategies for addressing them. Understand how to measure and communicate the benefits of Agile to stakeholders. "Expanding Agile across the Organization“. Understand how to scale Agile beyond individual teams to the entire organization. Identify different scaling frameworks, such as SAFe and LeSS. Learn how to manage dependencies and align work across multiple teams. Understand how to implement Agile governance and manage risks at the organizational level. Learn how to create a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in the organization. Identify common challenges in scaling Agile and strategies for addressing them. Understand the Scrum framework and its key components, including sprints, product backlog, and daily standup meetings. Learn how to create and prioritize user stories and plan sprints. Understand the role of the Scrum Master in facilitating the Scrum process and removing obstacles. Understand the role of the Product Owner in managing the product backlog and ensuring stakeholder needs are met. Learn how to conduct effective sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Identify common challenges in implementing Scrum and strategies for addressing them. Understand how Scrum can be used in different types of projects, such as software development and marketing campaigns. Agile Project Management with Kanban": Understand the Kanban framework and how it differs from Scrum. Learn how to visualize and manage work using a Kanban board. Identify different types of work items and how to prioritize them using Kanban. Understand the importance of limiting work in progress and how to implement pull-based workflow. Learn how to manage flow and identify bottlenecks using Kanban metrics. Understand how to continuously improve the Kanban process through regular review and adaptation. Identify common challenges in implementing Kanban and strategies for addressing them. Understand how Kanban can be used in different types of projects, such as software development and service delivery. This course delves into Agile Project Management fundamentals, covering principles, methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), and roles. It explores Agile implementation, addressing challenges and emphasizing organizational culture and structure. Additionally, the course extends into scaling Agile across the organization, covering frameworks, governance, and fostering continuous improvement. The Scrum module details roles, events, and artefacts, while the Kanban module focuses on its framework, work visualization, and continuous improvement strategies. The course equips participants with comprehensive Agile skills for effective project management. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Fundamentals of Agile Methods in Project Management. Implementing Agile within the Organization. Scrum Roles, Events and Artefacts.

title: Special Executive Programme In Analysing Risk Environmental
description: Develop expertise in identifying, managing, and mitigating business risks through effective risk management strategies.
longDescription: This programme explores the role of risk management within organizations, focusing on business risks and their impact. Participants will learn about risk control strategies, risk financing, and the techniques for assessing and mitigating organizational risks.
courseDetails: Understand the Various Types of Organisation Risk. Understand the Concept of Strategic Risk. Understand the Concept of Financial Risks. Understand the Concept of Operational Risk. Understand the Concept of Hazard Risks. Understand the Concept of Information Security Risk. Understand the Various Activities of High Risk in the Business Organisation. Identify Organisational Risks: Recognise and Categorise Potential Risks that May Pose Threats to an Organisation's Success and Operations. Explore Risk Control Strategies: Investigate Various Risk Control Techniques Such as Preventive, Detective, and Corrective Measures to Proactively Manage and Mitigate Identified Risks. Analyse Risk Control Effectiveness: Evaluate the Efficiency and Effectiveness of Implemented Risk Control Measures in Reducing the Likelihood and Impact of Organisational Risks. Understand Risk Financing Concepts: Comprehend the Basic Principles of Risk Financing and its Role in Addressing the Financial Consequences of Potential Risks. Explore Risk Financing Options: Investigate Different Risk Financing Options Including Insurance, Self-insurance, and Risk Retention to Determine Suitable Approaches for Handling Specific Organisational Risks. Understand the Techniques for Identifying Risks (E.G., SWOT Analysis, Risk Registers, Brainstorming) and Qualitative vs. Quantitative Risk Assessment. Learn Risk Scoring and Prioritisation Methods. Assess the Potential Impacts of Various Risks on Business Operations Known as Business Impact Assessment and Prioritise Critical Functions and Resources. Learn to Develop a Comprehensive Business Continuity Plan and Explore Emergency Response and Crisis Management Procedures. Analyse the Ways to Risk Monitoring and Control and Establish Key Risk Indicators and Triggers. The course begins by introducing the fundamentals of risk management, exploring different types of organizational risks including strategic, financial, operational, and hazard risks. Participants will analyze risk control techniques and evaluate the effectiveness of risk mitigation measures. The programme also delves into risk financing options such as insurance and self-insurance, and covers qualitative and quantitative risk assessment methods. Business continuity planning, emergency response, and crisis management procedures are also key components. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following: The Function of Risk Management in Organizations: Understanding Business Risks: Understanding Risk Control Through Risk Financing: Risk Assessment and its impact on Business:

title: Special Executive Programme In Company Law
description: Explore the evolution, structure, and key components of company law in the UK and EU.
longDescription: This Special Executive Programme covers concepts, evolution, and mechanisms of English company law. The course covers rules framing the activities of sole traders, public limited companies, private companies limited by shares, companies limited by guarantee, and unlimited companies. In addition, the course provides insight into various types of partnerships. On a practical level, the course explains the role and components of the articles of association and addresses the controversial issue of the corporate veil. Also, the course is designed to cover companies' duties, rights, and liquidation. The course covers the general duties of a company and the role and rights of majority and minority shareholders.
courseDetails: The course begins with the historical development of English company law and the concept of sole traders, followed by a comparison of different types of companies under UK and EU laws. title: Special Executive Programme In Corporate Reporting
description: The course aims to equip learners with a comprehensive understanding of corporate reporting by exploring key accounting principles, financial statements, regulatory frameworks, and corporate accounting practices.
longDescription: The Special Executive Program in Corporate Reporting aims to equip the learner with advanced knowledge of the concepts and methods used in corporate reporting by introducing different instruments and structures of financial and non-financial information that are needed to be reported in order to facilitate the decision-making at the top management. The learner will be able to understand, interpret and develop different reports and instruments to report the needed financial and non-financial information to the top management.
courseDetails: Define accounting and identify its importance in business. Discuss the history and evolution of financial accounting and its impact on modern business practices. Define financial statements and describe their purpose in providing a comprehensive view of a company's financial health. Analyze the components of a balance sheet and explain how it represents a company's financial position at a specific point in time. Examine the income statement and its role in showing a company's profitability over a period of time. Explain the purpose of a cash flow statement and its significance in assessing a company's ability to meet its financial obligations. Outline the key concepts of auditing, including its history, types of audits, the phases of an audit cycle, the role and functions of an auditor, and the essential skills required to perform a successful audit. Accounting information and its importance in providing key financial data to various stakeholders. Identify the different users of accounting information, including investors, creditors, and management, and describe their specific needs. Explain the various bases of preparing accounting information, including cash and accrual accounting, and how they impact financial reporting. Categorize accounting into its various types, such as financial, management, and tax accounting, and describe their unique roles in business. Analyze financial statements, including the balance sheet, income statement, and statement of cash flows, and interpret the data to assess a company's financial health. Describe the accounting methods used for non-current assets, including property, plant, and equipment, and intangible assets such as patents and copyrights. Explain the accounting treatment of business acquisitions, including goodwill and other intangible assets, and the impact on financial reporting. Also, outline the accounting procedures involved in the liquidation of a company, including the disposal of assets and settling of liabilities. Define financial reporting and its importance in providing stakeholders with transparent and accurate financial information. Explain financial regulation and its key elements, including establishing rules and guidelines, oversight and enforcement, and protecting investors and the public interest. Identify the financial regulators in the UK, such as the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA), and their respective roles in overseeing financial markets and institutions. Describe the IFRS regulatory framework and its importance in providing global accounting standards to promote transparency and comparability in financial reporting. Explain the GAAP framework and its role in providing accounting standards and guidelines for financial reporting in the United States. Analyze the differences between principles-based and rules-based accounting and their impact on financial reporting. Discuss the benefits of a financial regulatory framework, including increased transparency, accountability, and investor confidence, and the potential impacts on business organizations. Define UK accounting standards and their role in promoting consistent and transparent financial reporting practices in the UK. Explain corporate accounting and its key activities, including financial analysis, bookkeeping, and financial reporting. Define accounting events and their role in recording financial transactions and events in an organization. Understand amalgamation in accounting and its impact on financial reporting in the context of mergers and acquisitions. Describe corporate accounting practices and policies and their importance in promoting consistency and accuracy in financial reporting. Analyze the differences between corporate accounting practices and policies and their respective roles in financial reporting. The course provides a deep dive into the principles and theories behind accounting, along with the preparation and interpretation of financial statements such as the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement. Students will also explore auditing practices, learn about UK and international financial regulatory frameworks, and understand how corporate accounting policies influence organizational transparency and compliance. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Understanding Accounting Concepts, Principles and Theories: Understanding the Basics of Financial Statements & Auditing: Preparation and Interpretation of Accounting Information: Understanding the Accounting & Finance Regulatory Framework:

title: Special Executive Programme In Engagement Of Employees And Organizational Learning
description: The aim of this Special Executive course is to unlock the Secrets of Employee Engagement and Organisational Knowledge Management.
longDescription: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of effective employee engagement and the role of organizational learning in driving success. Participants will explore the key elements of employee engagement, including creating action plans, developing profiles, and fostering a culture that encourages active participation. Leadership's role in shaping engagement and applying continuous performance management tools to promote best practices will also be examined. In addition, the course delves into the fundamentals of organizational learning, focusing on identifying individual and organizational learning needs. Participants will explore various learning styles and evaluate effective organisational knowledge management strategies. By understanding these concepts, participants will be equipped to design initiatives that boost employee engagement and manage knowledge effectively, ensuring their organization stays competitive and innovative. This course is ideal for professionals looking to enhance organizational learning capabilities and develop a highly engaged workforce.
courseDetails: Different perspectives of learning at the organisational and individual levels. Understand how to identify the learning needs of the organisation and the individual. Evaluate different ways in which people learn. How knowledge can be managed by an organisation and how information can be transferred successfully within it. Understanding Organisation Knowledge. Learning Explicit Versus Tacit Knowledge. Understanding Successful Knowledge Management Strategies. Learning Knowledge Capture and Classification. Understanding Strategic Levers. Understanding Strategies for Managing Knowledge. Upon successfully completing the course "Engagement of Employees and Organizational Learning," participants will thoroughly understand key concepts and practices in employee engagement and organizational learning. Additionally, participants will explore organizational and individual learning perspectives, identify learning needs, and evaluate various learning methods. The course also covers the fundamentals of organizational knowledge, including explicit versus tacit knowledge, knowledge management strategies, capture and classification, and strategic levers for effective knowledge management. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Understanding Employee Engagement Concepts: Organisational Learning and Knowledge Management: Fundamentals of Organisational Knowledge:

title: Special Executive Programme In Fundamentals Of Risk Management
description: Explore the core principles and methodologies of risk management, focusing on operational risk in financial contexts.
longDescription: This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of operational risk, its significance, and various management approaches. Participants will learn about risk models, including the Black-Scholes Model, and the Basel Accords' frameworks for effective risk assessment.
courseDetails: The Concept of the Black Scholes Model. The Assumptions of the Black Scholes Merton Model. Various Risk Models. The Concept of the Ellsberg Paradox. Various Examples of Black Swan Events. Mathematical Models of Risk. The Elements of D.F.A. The Concept of Operational Risk and its Significance in Financial Management. Quantitative Standards When Utilising the Advanced Measurement Approach (Ama) for Operational Risk Management. The course begins with an exploration of operational risk, including its definition, types, and the foundational principles of operational risk management. Participants will examine the Basel Accords, particularly Basel II, and its event types related to operational risk. The programme covers various risk models, including the Black-Scholes Model, and introduces key concepts like the Ellsberg Paradox and Black Swan events. Lastly, it emphasizes different approaches to assessing and managing operational risk in banking, focusing on standardized and advanced measurement approaches. title: Special Executive Programme In Innovation And Entrepreneurship
description: This course offers a deep dive into innovation and entrepreneurship, empowering participants to develop creative solutions and drive transformative business ventures in competitive markets.
longDescription: The special executive program on Innovation and Entrepreneurship equips participants with a comprehensive understanding of the principles, processes, and practices essential for creating value and solving complex problems across various contexts. Through theoretical insights, case studies, and hands-on exercises, participants will develop the skills to identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities while building and managing innovative ventures in a rapidly evolving global economy. Additionally, participants will explore the role of innovation and entrepreneurship in fostering economic growth, job creation, and social impact, as well as the ethical responsibilities of entrepreneurs and innovators in today’s interconnected world.
courseDetails: Assess the opportunities and challenges associated with international entrepreneurship, including the importance of international business to firms and the differences between international and domestic entrepreneurship. Evaluate the process of entrepreneurial entry into international business, including different market entry methods and strategies for overcoming barriers to international trade, such as trade blocks and free trade areas. Analyze the role of entrepreneurs in generating new ideas and the methods used to generate and develop these ideas, such as creative problem-solving and other ideation techniques. Compare and contrast different sources of new ideas for entrepreneurs, including internal and external sources, and evaluate the benefits and drawbacks of each. Evaluate the effectiveness of different entrepreneurial strategies for overcoming trade barriers and expanding into international markets. Critically analyze the role of innovation in international entrepreneurship and the importance of adapting to local market conditions and cultural differences when developing and implementing international business strategies. Analyze the product planning and development process, including the criteria for assessing new business opportunities and establishing evaluation criteria. Evaluate the role of e-commerce in business start-up and growth, including the benefits and challenges of using the internet to start and grow a company. Assess the process of starting an e-commerce company, including website development, and evaluate the strategies used by entrepreneurial companies to succeed in e-commerce. Examine the importance of endorsement deals for entrepreneurial companies and identify three best practices for securing and executing successful endorsement deals. Evaluate the points to be considered while doing e-commerce, including the promotion of the website in all marketing materials and the role of the product life cycle in developing and marketing e-commerce products. Critically analyze the challenges and opportunities associated with doing e-commerce as an entrepreneurial company and identify the strategies and practices that can be used to overcome these challenges and capitalize on these opportunities. Analyze the role of planning as part of the business operation, including the purpose of a business plan and who should write it. Evaluate the scope and value of the business plan and identify the key stakeholders who read and evaluate it. Examine the information needs for a business plan and the use of the internet as a resource tool to support the planning process. Assess the process of using and implementing the business plan, including how to measure progress and why some business plans fail. Evaluate the elements of a marketing plan, including marketing research, and assess the benefits of using marketing research in the planning process. Critically analyze the marketing research process and identify the strategies and practices that can be used to develop effective marketing plans for entrepreneurial companies. Define the basic concepts and definitions related to innovation, such as creativity, invention, and diffusion, and differentiate between them. Evaluate different methods for measuring innovation, including input and output metrics, and explain their strengths and limitations. Describe the innovation process and its key stages, including idea generation, screening, testing, implementation, and diffusion. Analyze the role of knowledge in innovation, including the importance of tacit and explicit knowledge, and explain how knowledge management can support innovation. Identify different types of innovation, such as incremental, radical, and disruptive, and provide examples of each. Describe the characteristics of innovation, such as complexity, uncertainty, and risk, and explain how they influence the innovation process. Analyze the principles of technological innovation management, including technology scouting, road mapping, and open innovation, and explain how they can be applied in a business context. Evaluate strategies for enhancing a company's capacity for innovation, such as creating a culture of innovation, investing in R&D, and collaborating with external partners. The course on Innovation and Entrepreneurship provides a comprehensive understanding of entrepreneurship, including its nature, development, and role in economic growth. Participants will explore international entrepreneurial opportunities, focusing on market entry strategies, overcoming trade barriers, and the importance of innovation. description: The aim of the special executive programme is to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to manage and grow businesses in the global tourism industry, focusing on cross-cultural dynamics, sustainable practices, and international market strategies.
longDescription: The special executive programme provides a comprehensive understanding of the global tourism industry and the strategies needed to succeed in international tourism business. Participants will explore key areas such as market analysis, customer segmentation, destination management, and sustainable tourism practices. The course also covers the impact of globalization on tourism trends, focusing on international marketing, cross-cultural communication, and regulatory environments. In addition, participants will delve into the operational aspects of international tourism businesses, including supply chain management, service quality, and digital marketing strategies. The role of innovation and technology in shaping the future of tourism will be examined, along with the importance of responsible tourism practices that benefit both the economy and local communities. By understanding these concepts, participants will be equipped to develop and manage tourism ventures that cater to global markets while adhering to ethical and sustainable standards. This course is ideal for professionals looking to enhance their expertise in managing and growing tourism businesses in an increasingly interconnected world.

title: Special Executive Programme In International Trade Law
description: Explore the legal frameworks governing international trade and the roles of key institutions like the WTO.
longDescription: This Special Executive Programme covers essential topics relating to international trade and international sales contracts. First, this course explores international trade's legal and regulatory landscape and how this practice can negatively and positively impact economies, societies, and the environment. In addition, the course introduces some fundamental concepts, reflects on relevant market theories, and then presents an in-depth analysis of complex international trade agreements and mechanisms, including GATT and WTO. Second, the course explores the English legal and regulatory landscape of the sales of goods and the principles on which law practitioners draft and negotiate these contracts.
courseDetails: The course begins by examining the influence of international trade on global economies and environmental factors, as well as market theories. Participants will study the roles and functions of the World Trade Organization, the structure of sales contracts under English law, and the rights and obligations of parties in international sales. The programme also covers remedies for contract breaches, the application of incoterms rules, and key provisions of the Vienna Convention (CISG). title: Special Executive Programme In Investment Analysis
description: The course aims to provide participants with a comprehensive understanding of investment analysis, risk management, and portfolio optimization.
longDescription: This course covers fundamental principles of investment analysis, including risk-return assessment, portfolio management, and financial market instruments such as bonds, futures, and stocks.
courseDetails: Understand the fundamentals of bond market analysis, including the different types of bonds and their characteristics. Learn about the advantages and disadvantages of investing in bonds and how to assess whether they are the right investment option for you. Gain in-depth knowledge of the various classifications of bonds, such as government, corporate, and municipal bonds, and how they differ from each other. Discover the importance of macro-level analysis in bond investment, including factors such as interest rates, inflation, and economic indicators. Learn about the concept of options and futures and the role they play in financial markets and investment strategies. Understand the concept and uses of swaps, including interest rate swaps and currency swaps, and how they can be used to manage risk and optimize investment returns. Understand the concepts and applications of Economic, Technical and Fundamental Analysis in stock investment. Explain the Industry Life Cycle model and its impact on portfolio management decisions. Explore and analyze the Tools of Technical Analysis used in stock investment. Identify the Objectives of Portfolio Management and their importance in achieving financial goals. Learn about Markowitz's Portfolio Theory and its relevance in creating a well-diversified investment portfolio. Analyze the Market Efficiency Theory, Arbitrage Pricing Theory, and Capital Asset Pricing Model and their implications for stock investment strategies. Understand taxation's basic concept and purpose, its history, and its evolution in different societies and economic systems. Explore the fundamental principles of taxation and learn how they shape tax policy and practice. Analyze the nature of progressive and regressive taxes and their impact on income distribution and social justice. Distinguish between direct and indirect taxes and explore their respective characteristics, advantages, and disadvantages. Identify direct and indirect taxes and their application in other countries and economic systems. Evaluate the impact of taxation on investment decisions, including the role of tax in shaping savings, investment, and capital allocation. Describe the nature of investment risk and its potential impact on investment outcomes. Identify and differentiate between the types of investment risks, such as market risk, credit risk, and liquidity risk. Explain the nature and process of risk management, including risk identification, risk assessment, and risk mitigation. Analyze the nature of a risk mitigation plan and identify the key components that make it effective. Evaluate a range of risk mitigation methods used in investments, including diversification, asset allocation, and use of derivatives. Examine the concept of hedging in investments, including hedging strategies and the use of futures and options for speculation and arbitrage. Participants will explore key investment strategies, methods to assess risk and return, and advanced tools for portfolio diversification. By examining real-world financial instruments and taxation's role in investment decisions, learners will be equipped with skills to analyze and optimize investment portfolios while managing associated risks. title: Special Executive Programme In Law And Financial Crimes
description: Gain expertise in financial crime prevention, investigation, and regulatory compliance across global frameworks.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and Rushford Business School
longDescription: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the legal frameworks surrounding financial crimes and the methods used to combat them. Participants will explore key aspects of financial crimes, including fraud, money laundering, insider trading, and corruption, as well as the regulatory measures and enforcement mechanisms in place to prevent and address these offenses. The course also examines the role of both domestic and international financial institutions, regulators, and law enforcement agencies in combating financial crime.
courseDetails: Upon successfully completing the course "Law and Financial Crimes," participants will gain a thorough understanding of the legal frameworks, enforcement mechanisms, and regulatory strategies used to prevent and combat financial crimes. Additionally, participants will explore the key types of financial crimes, including money laundering, fraud, insider trading, and corruption, and will analyze both domestic and international approaches to addressing these offenses. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following: Understanding Financial Crimes: Learn about the various forms of financial crimes, including fraud, money laundering, insider trading, and corruption. Discover regulatory frameworks at national and international levels that govern financial crime prevention and prosecution. Analyze the role of financial institutions in monitoring and reporting suspicious activities. Investigative Techniques and Legal Enforcement: Understand the key investigative methods used to detect and prosecute financial crimes. Learn how to apply legal principles and compliance strategies to mitigate financial crime risks. Explore real-world case studies to understand enforcement challenges and best practices. Regulatory Compliance and Risk Management: Gain insights into regulatory compliance requirements for businesses and financial institutions. Learn how to implement risk management strategies to safeguard organizations against financial crime. Understand the role of international cooperation in enforcing financial crime laws and regulations. title: Special Executive Programme In Supply Chain Management
description: This programme equips professionals with essential knowledge in planning, managing, and optimizing supply chain operations for organizational success.
longDescription: The Special Executive Programme in Supply Chain Management offers a comprehensive study of planning models, inventory control, risk management, and quality improvement tools. Participants will gain expertise in the principles, tools, and technologies necessary for efficient and resilient supply chains.
courseDetails: Understand Supply Chain Planning (SCP) and its pivotal role in organizational success. Explore the tangible benefits derived from effective Supply Chain Planning. Identify key planning areas crucial for streamlined operations in the supply chain. Comprehend the significance of forecasting demand within the supply chain. Examine the criteria utilized in forecasting processes for enhanced accuracy. Acquire knowledge of a systematic approach to forecasting within supply chain management. Explore quantitative approaches employed in supply chain planning for data-driven decision-making. Delve into qualitative approaches utilized in planning to consider non-numeric factors impacting the supply chain. Comprehend the fundamentals of Supply Chain Analytics. Analyze the nature and advantages of Supply Chain Stimulation. Apply various simulation techniques in the context of Supply Chain Management. Understand the concept and implications of the Bullwhip Effect in supply chains. Evaluate the dynamic elements inherent in Supply Chain dynamics. Implement Monte Carlo Simulation Models in the context of supply chain scenarios. Utilize Agent-based Models for simulating and analyzing supply chain processes. Apply Cluster Analysis methodologies within the realm of Supply Chain dynamics. Implement Facility Location Methods to optimize supply chain networks. Understand the Concept, Types, and Importance of Inventory and Inventory Control. Grasp the Concept and Structure of Inventory Management. Analyze the Components Involved in Inventory Control Decision-Making. Evaluate Inventory Management Performance Metrics for Effective Assessment. Comprehend the Concept of the Inventory Management System. Understand the Concept of Customer Service Levels in the Context of Inventory Management. Solve Problems Related to Inventory Management using the Concept of the Newsvendor Problem. Apply General Inventory Control Techniques, including the Square Root Law. Recognize the Role of Information Technology (IT) in Inventory Management. Apply Six Sigma Tools and Methodology for Process Improvement. Identify and Analyze Key Drivers of Supply Chain for Effective Management. Evaluate the Importance of Supply Chain Integration and Understand the Role of IT in Enhancing Supply Chain Management. Demonstrate Proficiency in Utilizing Supply-Chain-Management Software for Efficient Operations. Understand the concept of Supply Chain Risk Management. Identify and analyze various Supply Chain Risk Management Strategies. Evaluate the effectiveness of Incentive Alignment strategies in Supply Chain contexts. Describe the Five Pillars of Supply Chain Resilience and their significance. Analyze the role and impact of Outsourcing in Supply Chain Management. Differentiate between Lean Strategy, Agile Strategy, and Leagile Strategy in Supply Chain contexts. Explain the concept and implementation of Vendor Managed Inventory System. Understand the principles and benefits of Collaborative Planning, Forecasting, and Replenishment in Supply Chain management. Analyze the causes and consequences of the Bullwhip Effect in Supply Chain dynamics. Understand the operational dynamics of Tim Hortons through a comprehensive case study analysis. Identify and delineate the distinct roles and responsibilities of Operations Managers and Supply Chain Managers within organizational contexts. Define and distinguish between order winner and order qualifier concepts in supply chain management, and analyze their significance in competitive strategies. Evaluate the six critical trade-offs that CEOs encounter when managing the supply chain, recognizing their implications for strategic decision-making. Explore Hayes and Wheelwright's framework of the four stages of operations, including its application in assessing organizational maturity and strategic alignment. Participants will explore supply chain planning, forecasting models, and analysis tools for operational efficiency. The programme covers inventory control methods, the role of IT in supply chain management, and Six Sigma methodologies. Additionally, participants will learn risk management strategies, the concept of vendor-managed inventory, and sustainable operations practices through case studies. The course emphasizes the integration of advanced supply chain technologies and sustainability practices. title: Special Executive Programme In Working Capital Management
description: This course focuses on strategies and techniques to analyze, forecast, and optimize working capital while reducing financing costs.
longDescription: Working Capital Management is a course that provides an in-depth understanding of managing a company's short-term assets and liabilities effectively. The course covers various topics, including working capital assessment, forecasting, and optimization techniques. It also explores strategies for inventory, accounts receivable, and accounts payable management, with the ultimate goal of maximizing liquidity while minimizing financing costs.
courseDetails: Understand the different types of Working Capital Investment Policies including Conservative, Aggressive, Highly Aggressive, and Hedging policies Understand the different sources of Working Capital Finance including Spontaneous and Negotiated Sources. Understand the time and money concept in Working Capital Management. Understand the need for Working Capital and its importance in the success of a business. Estimation of Amount of Different Components of Current Assets and Current Liabilities: Learn how to estimate the number of different components of Current Assets and Current Liabilities in order to manage Working Capital effectively. Understanding the different aspects of Cash Management. Identifying the motives for Holding Cash and Marketable Securities. Determining the factors that impact the Optimum Cash Balance. Defining the objectives of trade credit. Evaluating the different Credit policies. Analyzing the various dimensions of receivable management. Developing strategies for effective collections from receivables. Understanding the different Techniques of inventory management. Evaluating the different Methods of inventory valuation. Understand different methods of assessing working capital, such as operating cycle, percentage of sales, regression analysis, cash forecasting, and balance sheet methods. Gain knowledge about various methods of lending, including Tandon's First and Second methods and the cash budget method. The aim of the course Working Capital Management is to equip students with the knowledge and skills to manage a company's short-term assets and liabilities efficiently. Students will learn techniques to assess, forecast, and optimize working capital while reducing financing costs. The course aims to provide practical insights into the strategies for inventory, credit, and cash management to ensure that a company has sufficient liquidity to meet its short-term obligations. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Exploring the Concept of Working Capital Management: Understanding the Working Capital Investment Policies: Optimizing Business Operations: Assessment of Working Capital and Lending Methods:
